newsitem.title: USA: No significant currency misalignments - IMF chief.
newsitem.headline: No significant currency misalignments - IMF chief.

text.p: The IMF's policy-making Interim Committee does not believe that currency rates now are significantly out of line from where they should be, IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus said on Sunday.
"The Interim Committee considers that there is not at this stage a significant misalignment among currencies," the International Monetary Fund official toild reporters.
"The problem is now not so much to bring the currencies into a better constellation, but to preserve the constellation we have with appropriate macroeconomic policies," Camdessus added.
His comments echoed those he made last week in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
